releaseNotes:
v.2.2.8
    - Added packing-time trimming for source-defined attribute types in Programmable Block scripts and mods. Attribute applications and declarations are removed from packed source, while runtime references to those types stop packing with a diagnostic.
    - Attribute trimming removes only aliases and static imports that target trimmed attribute types, preserves surrounding comments and preprocessor directives, and skips mod source files made structurally empty by trimming.

v.2.2.7
    - Content files linked into a mod from outside its project - e.g. shared resources in a referenced shared project or submodule, declared as <AdditionalFiles Include="..\..\Shared\Content\..." Link="Content\..." /> - are now packed under Content\ using their Link path. Previously they were skipped, because their on-disk path relative to the project starts with "..\" and escaped the output directory. Mods using their own local Content\ are unaffected.

v.2.2.6
    - Fixed the type trimmer leaving unused method overloads in the script. When a call resolved to one overload, other same-named overloads the call could never bind to were mistakenly treated as referenced and kept. They are now trimmed like any other unused member. (#147)

v.2.2.5
    - Added per-branch mod output folders. [mdk-branch:<branch>] sections in mdk.ini map the current git branch to an output folder name pattern ($MDK_PROJECT$/$MDK_BRANCH$ macros available), so a branch can deploy to and publish a separate Workshop item. Packing aborts if branch sections are configured but the branch can't be determined, so a build never lands in the wrong mod.
    - Branch builds watermark their thumbnail by default: a translucent red stamp (watermarktext, or the branch name) is drawn onto thumb.png via SkiaSharp. Set watermark=false to disable. Best-effort with graceful fallback if no font is available.
    - mdk.local.ini branch sections take precedence over mdk.ini, consistent with all other settings.
    - The Hub build notification reports the deployed folder name, so branch-redirected builds show up as their own build instead of the project name.

v.2.2.5-pre.2
    - [mdk-branch:<branch>] sections now watermark the deployed thumbnail by default: a translucent red stamp (text from watermarktext, or the branch name) is drawn onto thumb.png via SkiaSharp. Set watermark=false to disable. Best-effort with graceful fallback if no font is available.
    - Fixed branch-section precedence so mdk.local.ini overrides mdk.ini for the same branch, consistent with all other settings.

v.2.2.5-pre.1
    - Added per-branch mod output folders. [mdk-branch:<branch>] sections in mdk.ini map the current git branch to an output folder name pattern (the $MDK_PROJECT$ and $MDK_BRANCH$ macros are available). On a matching branch the mod packs into that folder instead of the project-name folder, enabling a separate alpha/test Workshop item. If branch sections are configured but the current git branch cannot be determined, the pack is aborted to avoid publishing over the released mod.

v.2.2.4
    - `#if` directives now use the project's actual conditional compilation symbols. Previously the build configuration name (e.g., "Release") was treated as a `#if` symbol while user-defined constants and DEBUG/TRACE were ignored.
    - Mod projects are now automatically registered with the MDK Hub after a successful pack, the same way Programmable Block scripts already were.
    - The "MDK Hub Not Found" page now shows which marker file MDK looked at, what was in it, and whether it pointed to a real Hub install, so stale or misconfigured installations can be diagnosed at a glance.

v.2.2.4-pre.1
    - `#if` directives now use the project's actual conditional compilation symbols. Previously the build configuration name (e.g., "Release") was treated as a `#if` symbol while user-defined constants and DEBUG/TRACE were ignored.
    - Mod projects are now automatically registered with the MDK Hub after a successful pack, the same way Programmable Block scripts already were.
    - The "MDK Hub Not Found" page now shows which marker file MDK looked at, what was in it, and whether it pointed to a real Hub install, so stale or misconfigured installations can be diagnosed at a glance.

v.2.2.3
    - The "Mod projects are currently in beta" warning has been removed.
    - Mods using Roslyn source generators are now packed correctly.

v.2.2.3-pre.1
    - Mods using Roslyn source generators are now packed correctly.

v.2.2.2
    - Full minification now keeps enum and enum member names intact inside `#region mdk preserve`.
    - Full minification no longer breaks Whip's Scheduler by trimming required derived constructors.
    - Full minification now correctly keeps preserved unused members inside `#region mdk preserve`.
    - Full minification now keeps preserved trailing comments with the correct partial-class members instead of moving them to the end of `Program`.

v.2.2.1
    - Fixed "missing hub" web page showing the wrong way to disable the hub.

v.2.2.0
    - First stable 2.2 release, including source-generator packing fixes and recent CLI/packaging improvements.

v.2.2.0-pre.7
    - Scripts using Roslyn source generators are now packed correctly

v.2.2.0-pre.6
    - Macro replacement now works in Instructions.readme files

v.2.2.0-pre.5
   - Removed deprecated restore command
   - Interactive mode now loads from INI files as intended
   - MSBuild integration improvements for interactive mode control

v.2.2.0-pre.4
   - Bugfix: Unused field minification fix merged from main (v2.1.18)

v.2.2.0-pre.3
   - Linux support: MDK2 CLI and packagers now fully support Linux.
   - Packagers automatically detect your platform and use the correct binary.
   - Both Windows and Linux binaries included in the package.

v.2.2.0-pre.2
   - Linux compatibility: CLI now reads Hub's global path settings for auto-detection on Linux.
   - Interactive mode fully integrated with Hub for cross-platform build notifications.
   - Improved path handling for cross-platform reliability.

v.2.2.0-pre.1
   - Introducing MDK Hub: A visual application for managing projects, checking for updates, and configuring settings.
   - Interactive mode now integrates with the Hub for build notifications and updates.
   - Cross-platform support for Windows and Linux.

v.2.1.18
   - Bugfix on unused field minification

v.2.1.17
   - Moved the "Smallifier" processor to the Trim minifying level.

v.2.1.16
   - `MinifierLevel=none` would still trim code. Now we early exit TypeTrimmer if `MinifierLevel=none`.
   - replacements would replace unknown keys with nothing. Now unknown keys f.ex. `$UNMATCHED$` is left alone.
   - `abstract class Base { public abstract void Tick(); } class Derived : Base { public override void Tick() {} }` - base abstract member could be removed even though it must exist for the override.
   - `class Base { public Base() { /* side effects */ } } class Derived : Base {}` - base parameterless ctor could be trimmed even though derived types call it implicitly.
   - `class Registrar { static readonly int _x = Register(); int P { get; } = Register(); }` - side‑effecting field/property initializers could be removed.
   - `class Factory<T> where T : new() { T Create() => new T(); } var f = new Factory<A>();` - A’s parameterless ctor could be removed even though `new()` requires it.

v.2.1.15
   - Fix hardcoded paths causing issues on Linux due to relative paths using '.\' on Mod Packer

v.2.1.14
   - Extended dead code removal to also remove: methods, fields, properties, delegates besides just entirely unused types. An extra option in mdk.ini, minifyextraoptions, allows you to opt out from trimming.

v.2.1.13
   - Extended macro replacements such as "$MDK_DATETIME$" to work everywhere in scripts and mods, and not just in mdk regions like "#region mdk preserve"

v.2.1.12
   - Fixed a dum-dum error causing just the project filename to be passed down rather than the full path, causing the project file to not be found. PSA: There's no such thing as "just a small harmless fix". Test your code.

v.2.1.11
   - Changed: ini files are now exposed as AdditionalFiles to enable analyzer integration
   
v.2.1.10
   - LordMike added Compact field declarations in CodeSmallifier (combine separate variable declarations of the same type into multi-declaration)
   - LordMike fixed linq queries
   
v.2.1.9
   - Fixed 'mdk help pack' and 'mdk help restore' commands which were broken

v.2.1.8
   - Fix Issue #98: nameof() expressions not renamed with name conflicts
   - mdk.ini and mdk.local.ini are now primary file names rather than {project}.mdk.ini and {project}.mdk.local.ini

v.2.1.7
   - Added support for thumb formats other than png (ex: thumb.jpg, thumb.bmp, thumb.gif) to Script Packer.

v.2.1.6
   - Fixed minifier newline handling breaking when referencing minified code from preserved code.
   
v.2.1.5
   - Removed a bad compilation stage which caused custom namespace usings to fail a build rather than just being renoved.

v.2.1.4
   - Now supports a Content folder in the mod folder, instead of copying everything from the root. This update is
     not breaking, as the project file still determines what the content files are, but any new projects created
     from the updated template will use the new folder structure.

v.2.1.2
   - Mod packing: When copying mixin code, relative paths (..\ etc) were not forced into the mod folder.

v.2.1.1
   - Missing files, missing files, missing files... Microsoft, you'll end me.

v.2.1.0
   - DotNet 9 Compatibility _for real_ this time... and also a little less iffy for the .net 8 users (they'll be told
     to update rather than just crash).
   - Mod Packer is now available: Use `mdk2 pack` to pack your mod for distribution the same way you can pack your 
     scripts. Note this is currently rather experimental.

v.2.0.15
   - DotNet 9 Compatibility

v.2.0.14
   - Fixed a problem where references to nested types would be replaced by a "var" by the minifier.

v.2.0.13
   - Readded missing binaries

v.2.0.12
   - Fixed test that failed due to missing references. Attempt to clean up files that shouldn't be committed.
   - Update to gitignore
   - Fixed a problem where object-initializing a generic type would cause a compile error after minification.

v.2.0.11
   - Ignored documents were not always properly ignored in the project, which in certain rare cases could cause a 
     compile error.

v.2.0.10
   - Fixed nuget version checks not working properly.
   - Much improved qualified name handling in the minifier + leaving `var` as is.

v.2.0.9
   - Fixed #40: missing MSBuild instance just crashing MDK rather than giving a meaningful error message.
   - Fixed #42 verbatim variables was not renamed correctly in the minifier

v.2.0.8
   - Added symbol map generation to trace mode to help with debugging minification issues.
   - Fixed more problems with minifier not renaming things it should have and vice versa.

v.2.0.7
   - Fixed a problem where the minifier replaced a `var` with an incorrect type reference. Now leaving `var` as is.
   - Now removing `private` and `internal` access modifiers where they are redundant.

v.2.0.6
   - Fixed a problem where a quirk in Roslyn behavior for indexers would cause a compile error after minification.
   - Added the missing <mdk sortorder="#"/> feature.

v.2.0.5
    - Package was not defined as a development dependency

v.2.0.4
 - Reverted a convenience fix that caused more trouble than convenience...
 
v.2.0.3
 - Fixed a problem where references to generic methods would not be renamed with the full minifier.
 - Fixed a problem where delegates would not be renamed with the full minifier.
 - Intermediate code files are now written to the \obj folder when trace is enabled.
 
v.2.0.2
 - Fixed a problem where generic method declarations didn't get their generic parameters renamed with the full minifier.
 - Fixed a problem where the full minifier did not rename catch clause variables
 - Fixed a problem where the full minifier would rename references to protected symbols
 
v.2.0.1
 - Simplified how project properties are defined and used as their complexity was unnecessary.
 - Restore now checks the other packages for updates as well.

v.2.0.0
 - Official release of MDK2 (Programmable Block Edition)

v.2.0.0-alpha073
 - Minifiers Ahoy! (the two last major minifier components are now in place)

v.2.0.0-alpha072
 - Fixed a bug where references to sub-namespaces would cause compile errors. 

v.2.0.0-alpha061
 - Fixed warning about unusable minifier

v.2.0.0-alpha060
 - Wrong / confusing error message for a part of the minifier that isn't finished yet
  
v.2.0.0-alpha059
 - Fixed type trimmer removing types it shouldn't have, and vice versa.
  
v.2.0.0-alpha058
 - Fixed minifier specification being wrongly named in the package arguments (minifier instead of minify).

v.2.0.0-alpha057
 - Fixed minifier specification being wrongly named in the MDK2 command line (minifier instead of minify).

v.2.0.0-alpha056
 - Added the type trimmer minifier level to the MDK2 command line.
 - Added the comment removal minifier level to the MDK2 command line.

v.2.0.0-alpha054
 - Fixed an issue where the mdk2 .ini file ignores were made with ; as a separator rather than ,.

v.2.0.0-alpha052
